title: Linking Clauses: 虽然…但是, 如果…就, 不但…而且, 除了…以外, 要么…要么
description: Although, if … then, not only … but also, except / besides, and either … or.

points.title: 虽然 … 但是 / 可是 …: although
points.summary: Unlike English, Chinese uses both: 虽然 A，但是 B.
points.body: - **虽然**他很忙，**但是**每天都运动.
examples: {虽然|suīrán}{这个|zhège}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{辣|là}，{但是|dànshì}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎochī}。
Although this dish is spicy, it's delicious.

points.title: 如果 … (的话)，就 …: if … then
points.summary: 如果 A (的话)，(subject) 就 B. 的话 and 就 are optional but common.
points.body:
- **如果**明天下雨，我们**就**不去了.
- **如果**你有时间**的话**，来我家玩儿吧.
examples: {如果|rúguǒ}{明天|míngtiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒmen}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。
If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

points.title: 不但 … 而且 …: not only … but also
points.summary: 不但 A，而且 (还 / 也) B. With one subject, put it **before** 不但.
points.body: - 他**不但**会说英语，**而且**会说法语.
examples: She's not only pretty but also clever.

points.title: 除了 … 以外，都 / 也 / 还
points.summary: 除了 X 以外 + **都** = everyone except X. 除了 X 以外 + **也 / 还** = besides X (X included).
points.body:
- 除了小王以外，大家**都**来了 (Everyone except Wang came).
- 除了中文以外，我**还**学过日语 (Besides Chinese, I've also studied Japanese).

points.title: 要么 … 要么 …: either … or
points.summary: 要么 A，要么 B = it's one or the other (a choice to be made).
points.body: - 周末我们**要么**去爬山，**要么**在家看电影.
examples: Either you come or I go — you choose.

notes: 如果 doesn't pair with 但是.
questions.translation: Although he's busy, he exercises every day.

notes: 而且 = 'moreover' — clashes with 虽然.
questions.translation: Although this dish is spicy, it's delicious.

questions.prompt: {如果|rúguǒ}{明天|míngtiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒmen}（　）{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。
notes: 才 = 'only then' — doesn't fit 不去了.
questions.translation: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

questions.prompt: （　）{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{时间|shíjiān}{的话|dehuà}，{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{玩儿|wánr}{吧|ba}。
notes: 因为 = 'because' — doesn't go with 的话.
questions.translation: If you have time, come round to my place.

questions.explanation: Not only … but also: **不但…而且**.
questions.translation: He speaks not only English but also French.

notes: 不但 pairs with 而且, not 但是.
不但 comes first, 而且 second.
One subject goes before 不但; 很 goes before the adjective.
questions.translation: She's not only pretty but also clever.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means 'Everyone came except Xiao Wang'?
notes: 也 = 'besides Wang, others came too' (Wang came as well).
都 = 'except' — but there's only one subject (我).
questions.translation: Besides Chinese, I've also studied Japanese.

questions.prompt: {周末|zhōumò}{我们|wǒmen}（　）{去|qù}{爬山|páshān}，{要么|yàome}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kàn}{电影|diànyǐng}。
notes: The pair is 要么…要么.
questions.translation: At the weekend we'll either go hiking or watch a film at home.

notes: 不是 doesn't pair with 要么.
questions.translation: Either you come or I go — you choose.
